text: Мы храним данные банковских карт пользователей у себя?
note: The reply is a denial; the payments section repeats it as background.

spans.quote: Нет. Данные карт мы у себя не храним вообще, ни в базе, ни в логах — только токен, который отдаёт платёжный провайдер.

text: Можно отправлять участникам пуш-напоминания перед занятием?
note: Yes, only after legal approves the opt-in text and only to opted-in members.

spans.quote: Yes, you can send them, but only once our legal team has signed off the opt-in wording, and only to members who actually opted in.

text: Did Aqualine approve the loyalty programme in the spec?
note: Headings approved, the content of section 5 was not.

spans.quote: Section headings and their order are approved, please lock the structure. The content of section 5 (the loyalty point values and tiers) is NOT approved — Hendrik from finance has to go through the numbers first.

note: Proposed by Igor, nobody accepted or rejected it.

text: How late can a member cancel a class without being charged?
note: Spec says 12 hours, the live marketing text says 24 hours; nobody resolved it.

spans.quote: Подтверждаю перенос: запуск 17 ноября. 1 ноября не успеваем из-за ревью Apple и security review, Sam согласовал.

text: Which payment provider does Tidepool use?
note: Stripe from the kickoff was replaced by Adyen in spec v2.

spans.quote: Платёжный провайдер — Adyen. У Aqualine есть корпоративный договор с Adyen с более низкой комиссией, поэтому интеграцию со Stripe мы не делаем.
Adyen is confirmed, our merchant account is AqualineGmbH_App.

text: Is the Apple Watch app part of v1?
note: Agreed in chat, dropped at the steering meeting.

spans.quote: The Watch companion — let's take it out. Not in v1, and not planned for v2 either for now. It's a nice-to-have and it's eating Timur's time.
После steering: часы убрали из скоупа.

note: Reversal buried in the weekly status.

spans.quote: Отдельно: от входа через VK ID отказываемся. Остаются Sign in with Apple, Google и email-ссылка. Причина — юристы Aqualine не хотят передавать данные в ещё одну систему, Sam подтвердил в почте.

text: What is the minimum iOS version we support?
note: iOS 15+ was raised to 16; the reversal is in Russian with different wording.

spans.quote: По айфонам: устройства на пятнадцатой системе больше не поддерживаем, нижняя планка теперь шестнадцатая. Навигация на SwiftUI там разваливается, а таких пользователей у Aqualine меньше 3%.

text: When is Alex doing the security review?
note: Alex Brandt (Aqualine IT security), not Alex the Android developer.

spans.quote: Alex Brandt from our IT security will do the security review on 21–23 October.

text: Какой бюджет на Apple Search Ads к запуску?
note: The campaign is mentioned, the budget never is.
Hetzner Falkenstein; IT security later asked about Azure, decision stayed.

spans.quote: Бэкенд и база — у нас на Hetzner, дата-центр Falkenstein, EU. Sam, вас это устраивает?
Yes, Hetzner in Germany is fine for us. Agreed.

text: How many days in advance can members book a class?
note: 14 days; a later request for a month was turned down.

spans.quote: Members can book up to 14 days ahead, not more. That's how our trainers' rotas work.
Записаться на занятие можно не раньше чем за 14 дней до его начала.
